phrase: a traditional kyrgyz manaschi performing part of the epic of manas at a yurt camp in karakol , kyrgyzstan the use of the term "literature" here poses some issues due to its origins in the latin littera , "letter," essentially writing. alternatives such as "oral forms" and "oral genres" have been suggested, but the word literature is widely used.
